usage: 鹹魚雞粒 is a noun representing a specific dish made with salted fish and diced chicken.
It can be used as a subject or object in a sentence when talking about food or ordering meals.
The word can be combined with verbs such as 食 (to eat), 煮 (to cook), or 餐廳有 (the restaurant has).
鹹魚雞粒 is often found on menus or discussed when recommending dishes at seafood restaurants.
You can use it in sentences to express preference, inquiry, or recommendation about this dish.
